programmes.structure_summary: Generic 3-year academic CS master's (plan revised July 2020, hosted on the school website in 2025) with a 'course study + thesis' two-stage model. The first-level discipline is described as relying on the Tianhe-2 supercomputer platform of the Guangzhou supercomputing centre, with high-performance computing, big data and AI as three strength areas. The computer-architecture direction covers network technology and high-performance computing. Professional compulsory courses include Parallel and Distributed Computing, Advanced Computer Architecture, Distributed Operating Systems, Numerical Analysis, Matrix Analysis and Quantum Computation; electives include High Performance Computer System Architecture, Performance Analysis of Computer and Network Systems, High Performance Communication Network, Computer Simulation and Linux Application and Development Technology.

programmes.structure_summary_fr: Master académique d'informatique généraliste en 3 ans (plan révisé en juillet 2020, publié sur le site de l'école en 2025), en deux temps : cours puis mémoire. La discipline de premier niveau est décrite comme s'appuyant sur la plateforme du supercalculateur Tianhe-2 du centre de supercalcul de Canton, avec le calcul haute performance, les données massives et l'IA comme trois domaines forts. La direction architecture des ordinateurs couvre les technologies réseau et le calcul haute performance. Les cours professionnels obligatoires comprennent Calcul parallèle et distribué, Architecture avancée des ordinateurs, Systèmes d'exploitation distribués, Analyse numérique, Analyse matricielle et Calcul quantique ; les options comprennent Architecture des systèmes informatiques haute performance, Analyse de performance des systèmes informatiques et réseaux, Réseaux de communication haute performance, Simulation informatique et Technologies de développement et d'application Linux.

programmes.structure_summary: 3-year academic master's of the UCAS first-level discipline Computer Science and Technology with a credit system (>= 30 course credits). Professional courses are split into core (60 h, 3 credits, e.g. Computer Architecture), popularisation (40 h, 2 credits) and seminar courses (20 h, 1 credit). The popularisation list contains High Performance Computing Systems, Parallel and Distributed Computing, Concurrent Data Structures and Multicore Programming, Cloud Computing Technology, Intelligent Computing Systems, Big Data Analysis and Deep Learning. The UCAS course system publishes full syllabi for more HPC courses (Parallel Processing, Introduction to High Performance Computing, GPU Architecture and Programming, Distributed and Parallel Computing, High Performance Computing and Applications) covering OpenMP, MPI, CUDA, roofline, RDMA/IB verbs and parallel file systems.

programmes.notes: Programme-level rules come from the UCAS CS first-level discipline plan (file hosted by the UCAS AI school, undated, 2024 upload); individual training units (e.g. ICT-CAS) may apply different durations. Syllabi were read for 5 courses on jwba.ucas.ac.cn; 'High Performance Computing Systems' syllabus (code 180086081201P3004H) was not retrieved, so sysadmin, scheduling, containers-k8s, hpc-software-eng and observability-sre stay null (unknown), not 0. Course attribute of Advanced Computer Architecture differs between the syllabus (core, 60 h, 3 credits) and the plan table (popularisation, 40 h, 2 credits). Topic scores: MPI/OpenMP/CUDA rated by syllabus chapters inside elective courses; dedicated-course score 2 only for GPU programming, multicore concurrency, architecture, cloud, big data, ML. No Slurm/Kubernetes content visible: fills the 'GPU programming + MPI + architecture' gap of the course but not scheduling or cluster operations.
programmes.structure_summary_fr: Master académique en 3 ans de la discipline de premier niveau Informatique et technologie de l'UCAS, en système de crédits (au moins 30 crédits de cours). Les cours professionnels se répartissent en cours de base (60 h, 3 crédits, par exemple Architecture des ordinateurs), cours de vulgarisation (40 h, 2 crédits) et séminaires (20 h, 1 crédit). La liste de vulgarisation contient Systèmes de calcul haute performance, Calcul parallèle et distribué, Structures de données concurrentes et programmation multicœur, Technologie du cloud, Systèmes de calcul intelligents, Analyse de données massives et Apprentissage profond. Le système de cours de l'UCAS publie des programmes complets pour d'autres cours HPC (Traitement parallèle, Introduction au calcul haute performance, Architecture et programmation GPU, Calcul distribué et parallèle, Calcul haute performance et applications) couvrant OpenMP, MPI, CUDA, le roofline, les verbes RDMA/IB et les systèmes de fichiers parallèles.

programmes.structure_summary: Generic 2-3 year academic CS master's whose six second-level directions are theoretical CS, computer architecture, software, networks and security, AI and applied computing. Compulsory professional courses (>= 8 credits) are split into a foundation list (e.g. Computational Methods, Advanced Numerical Analysis, Combinatorial Optimization), core group I (Advanced Algorithm Design and Analysis, Advanced Computer Architecture, Advanced Distributed Systems, Advanced Computer Networks, Advanced AI, Machine Learning...) and core group II (reinforcement learning, deep learning frontiers...). No dedicated MPI, OpenMP, GPU programming, scheduling or storage course appears in the lists read. Cluster experience comes from the campus Taiyi cluster and the student supercomputing team (third consecutive ASC first prize in 2023).

programmes.notes: Plan dated 2025-05-09, hosted 2026-02 on the department site. It lists course titles only: MPI/OpenMP/GPU/scheduling/storage/containers/cloud are null (unknown), not 0, even though no course title names them. Low HPC relevance as a degree; the value for the learner is the cluster (Taiyi uses LSF, not Slurm, and Omni-Path, not InfiniBand) and the competition team. The Taiyi user manual is undated and describes an early configuration. A search-result snippet (not opened) mentions a university-wide course 'High Performance Computing: Methods and Practice' (MAE5032) in SUSTech mechanics programmes: unverified lead only. The department programme page https://cse.sustech.edu.cn/graduate/program/ itself renders no text in the cache; the PDF was reached through its attachment link.
programmes.structure_summary_fr: Master académique d'informatique généraliste de 2 à 3 ans, dont les six directions de second niveau sont l'informatique théorique, l'architecture des ordinateurs, le logiciel, les réseaux et la sécurité, l'IA et l'informatique appliquée. Les cours professionnels obligatoires (au moins 8 crédits) se répartissent en une liste de fondation (par exemple Méthodes de calcul, Analyse numérique avancée, Optimisation combinatoire), un groupe de base I (Conception et analyse avancées d'algorithmes, Architecture avancée des ordinateurs, Systèmes distribués avancés, Réseaux avancés, IA avancée, Apprentissage automatique...) et un groupe de base II (apprentissage par renforcement, avancées de l'apprentissage profond...). Aucun cours dédié à MPI, OpenMP, la programmation GPU, l'ordonnancement ou le stockage n'apparaît dans les listes lues. L'expérience des clusters vient du cluster Taiyi du campus et de l'équipe étudiante de supercalcul (troisième premier prix consécutif à l'ASC en 2023).
